reason: As a judge, I'd mark down B on sight: it has blank brackets for the clinic name, the county, the funding source and the plan to refill the departing attorney's job, so it can't be scored as written. A is complete and its funding math is convincing, but it presents the grant as refilling the departing attorney's job rather than adding a third attorney. It also claims there is no other money to refill that job, which the facts don't support. That honesty problem is why A wins by only a slight margin.
